data.about_content:
The Online MBA in Marketing Management by IGNOU is aimed at upskilling marketing skills among students in addition to business knowledge so that students can acquire world-class academic learning in marketing. The IGNOU Online MBA in Marketing Management is an online 2 year postgraduate degree recognized by the AICTE.

The Marketing Management in Online MBA by IGNOU follows an entirely online learning methodology suitable for working professionals. The main subjects of the IGNOU online MBA in marketing include consumer behavior, sales management, product and brand management, and international marketing. The program matches the global academic standards with its contemporary curriculum and latest study material.

highlights.highlight_title: IGNOU Online MBA has a contemporary curriculum and the latest study material.
IGNOU Online University offers 116 credit points for an Online MBA that will be deposited in the student’s ABC (Academic Bank of Credit) account.
IGNOU Online University provides synchronous mentoring and assessment with the help of its specified Regional Centres.
Asynchronous counseling/mentoring is provided in IGNOU Online MBA in OER/Video format.
IGNOU Online University evaluates students based on assignments (30% weightage ) and end-term exams (70% weightage ).
A robust mechanism for the redressal of student grievances is also provided in IGNOU Online MBA.

data.eligibility_content:
Candidates willing to enroll in the Online MBA program at IGNOU Online University must meet the following eligibility requirements-

  • Passed a bachelor's degree with a minimum of 3 years in any discipline from a recognized university.
  • Scored at least 50% marks in graduation(45% for the reserved category).
  • No age bar.
data.admission_steps:
Working professional and fresh graduates who are willing to pursue the IGNOU Online MBA program are required to follow the step-by-step admission process of the program listed below:

Step 1. Visit the official IGNOU website and register yourself.

Step 2. Click on Apply Now tab and start filling out your IGNOU online MBA application process.

Step 3. Fill in the required details and attach the supporting documents along with the application form.

Step 4. Pay the program fee and submit the application form.

Step 5. Print out the application form for future reference and wait for admission confirmation from the university.
data.syllabus_content:
The IGNOU online MBA in Marketing Management syllabus comprises a total of 21 courses, each of 4 credits, summing up to 84 credits.

Apart from the core management courses such as Management and Organizational Processes, Human Resource Management, and Marketing Management, the program consists of specialization-centric courses in the field of marketing, which are Consumer Behavior, Sales Management, Product and Brand Management, and International Marketing.
